findings.title: Optimistic Concurrency & Version-Predicate CAS in Answer Ledger Persistence
findings.description: Non-atomic read-then-upsert in saveAttemptAnswer permitted concurrent client writes to silently overwrite newer response data without version checking.
findings.resolution: Implemented atomic CAS via prisma.attemptResponse.updateMany({ where: { id: existing.id, version: input.clientVersion }, data: { ... version: nextVersion } }). Rejections return STALE_REJECTED with authoritative current row. Unique constraint handles first-time concurrent inserts safely.

findings.title: Server-Authoritative Deadline Finalization & Background Sweeps
findings.description: Client network latency grace windows could leak unauthorized post-expiry answer submissions, and abandoned attempts remained IN_PROGRESS indefinitely.
findings.resolution: Enforced strict zero-grace deadline check on server answer saves (MCQJ-ERR-6003, 403 Forbidden). Implemented finalizeOverdueAttempts background sweep that detects overdue sessions and triggers atomic evaluation.

findings.title: Race-Proof Idempotent Final Submission Handling
findings.description: Rapid double-click on Final Submit or concurrent auto-submit triggered duplicate evaluation attempts or database unique constraint collisions.
findings.resolution: Applied atomic status CAS on submitExamAttempt requiring status IN_PROGRESS or EXPIRED to transition to SUBMITTED. Subsequent requests immediately return the authoritative evaluation v1 idempotently.

findings.title: React 19 Render-Phase Side-Effect in ExamDeliveryClient
findings.description: Dispatching async Server Action persistAnswer directly inside functional state updaters (setResponses) violated React pure render constraints, throwing 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'.
findings.resolution: Separated optimistic state transition from network dispatch. Async persistence executes strictly after synchronous state updates in top-level event handlers.

findings.title: Turbopack HMR Keepalive Hang in Browser E2E Test Suite
findings.description: Using page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' }) under Next.js 16 Turbopack hung indefinitely due to persistent HMR EventSource streams.
findings.resolution: Switched navigation wait policy to domcontentloaded combined with explicit Playwright locator visibility checks (locator.waitFor({ state: 'visible' })). Tests execute 100% reliably in sub-second steps.
